attchmntText: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 19, 2026, titled "Greaves Cotton Accelerates Global Marine Business Expansion Through Multiflex Marine; Targets Europe as a Key Growth Market".
voiceSummary: Greaves Cotton Limited filed a press release with the BSE and NSE on 19th November 2026. The release details the company's acceleration of global marine business expansion through its subsidiary Multiflex Marine. The company targets Europe as a key growth market. This activity is part of the GREAVES.NEXT strategy. The expansion is being showcased at METSTRADE 2026 in Amsterdam from 17th to 19th November 2026. Multiflex Marine has a presence in over 65 countries. It serves more than 400 customers through approximately 200 distributors. The company launched the Multiflex Hydraulic Steering System for 90HP to 500HP outboard applications. It also soft launched Multiflex Electric Trim Tabs. The press release includes forward-looking statements regarding future expectations.

attchmntText: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of Mr Varun Gupta as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. November 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited has intimated the resignation of Mr. Varun Gupta, Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel. attchmntText: Apex Frozen Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Apex Frozen Foods Limited filed a transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on 16th November 2026. The company reported total shrimp sales volumes of 2,973 metric tons in Q2 FY27, a 14% year-on-year increase. Average shrimp realization was INR874 per kilo. Net revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 15% year-on-year to INR274 crores. Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR2 crores, impacted by an INR10.10 crores provision for antidumping duty. For H1 FY27, net revenue increased 7% to INR530 crores. Profit after tax for the half-year rose 13% to INR24 crores. The debt-to-equity ratio was 0.04x as of September 2026. Management expects EU FDA benefits by early 2027.

attchmntText: Beta Drugs Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 19, 2026, titled "Beta Drugs Limited ( Beta ) forms Oncology Joint Venture withIMGSA Groupe SPA ( IMGSA )".
voiceSummary: Beta Drugs Limited formed an Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA in Algeria. Beta holds a 49% stake while IMGSA holds 51%. The JV will acquire IMGSA’s oncology formulation plant for US$8.7 million. Beta will infuse US$3 million over 3 years and transfer formulation technology. IMGSA will settle part of the consideration via equity shares. Beta appoints the CEO and manages day-to-day operations. The board comprises five directors, with three from Beta and two from IMGSA. The plant is qualified by the Algerian regulatory authority for national tenders. The transaction is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals.

attchmntText: Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Kokuyo Camlin Limited disclosed an order from the Office of the Commissioner Appeals, Central Goods and Services Tax Appeals Commissionerate, Jammu, regarding an Excise Duty Demand of Rs. 5,50,14,380. The demand relates to refund claims under the J&K area-based exemption scheme for the company's Samba unit. The tax department alleged the company availed excess refunds based on a special value addition rate rather than the standard rate. The company received the demand notice on 18th November 2026. Kokuyo Camlin stated there is no material impact on its financials, operations, or other activities. The company intends to file an appeal with CESTAT Chandigarh against this order.

attchmntText: Beta Drugs Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
voiceSummary: Beta Drugs Limited approved a joint venture agreement with IMGSA Groupe SPA to establish a company in Algeria for manufacturing and marketing oncology pharmaceutical products. Beta will hold a 49% stake, while IMGSA will hold 51%. Beta will manage day-to-day operations and appoint the CEO. The joint venture will acquire an oncology plant from IMGSA for USD 8.7 million. Beta’s investment includes USD 3 million in cash over three years and technology transfer valued at USD 1.26 million. IMGSA will contribute USD 4.43 million in plant and machinery. The joint venture company is yet to be incorporated. The transaction is subject to customary closing formalities. Neither party holds shares in the other. The agreement does not constitute a related party transaction at this stage.

attchmntText: Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI LODR ) including circulars issued thereunder and other applicable provisions, if any, as amended from time to time, and in continuation to our intimation dated October 27, 2026, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. November 03, 2026 commenced at 16:00 Hrs (IST) and concluded at 18:15 Hrs (IST) has, inter-alia, considered and approved the following along with other matters:a) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, together with Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditors, that were placed before the Board of Directors and was taken on record.b) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Assets and Liabilities as on September 30, 2026.c) On the recommendation of the Audit Committee, Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Cash Flow for the half year ended September 30, 2026.d) Approved proposed capacity expansion by addition of new channels at various locations.e) Brand Launch: On 3 November,2026, the SKF Vertevo brand is officially launched across theorganization and to our customers and stakeholders worldwide. The brand is the face of ourcompany, it shows our personality   what we stand for, what we are passionate about and what our customers can expect from us.The SKF Vertevo brand is inspired by the world of racing, where the company has contributed to automotive innovation for decades. The identity is designed to keep a connection to the long SKF heritage and expertise, while signalling its ambition to help accelerate the future of mobility.Please note that only the brand is being launched, while the company name continues to remain the same. Any further developments will be communicated to stakeholders as and when applicable.Note: The company had already submitted the financial results for the period ended 30-Sep-2026 on 03rd November 2026. The company is re-submitting the same intimation in machine-readable format as instructed by NSE.
voiceSummary: SKF India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 03, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow. Statutory Auditors Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued an Unmodified opinion on these results. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 5,958.1 million, with a profit after tax of Rs. 518.1 million. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, consolidated revenue was Rs. 13,090.6 million, and profit after tax was Rs. 1,054.9 million. The Board also approved a proposed capacity expansion involving the addition of new channels at various locations. Additionally, the company launched the SKF Vertevo brand on November 03, 2026, while retaining the existing company name.
